Expires: 10/10/2026 What Does Steel Dynamics Do?Steel Dynamics is a leading industrial metals solutions company that produces lower-carbon, high-quality steel products primarily from recycled scrap. By combining technical analysis, CAD design, and process improvement projects with practical mechanical maintenance, Steel Dynamics provides interns with a unique opportunity to develop both engineering expertise and practical skills that are highly valued in the industry. conduct system diagnostics, efficiency testing, and CAD modeling for design upgrades; assist in implementing automated monitoring technologies to enhance operational reliability.Replace and redesign scrap car generators to improve power efficiency, including selecting upgraded components, working with vendors, and overseeing installation to minimize downtime and improve energy use.Design and fabricate simplified slag doors using CAD software and collaborate with external fabricators to produce parts; develop and install a custom slag chute to reduce buildup on the melt deck, improving safety and operational flow.Install platform walkways to improve accessibility and operator safety; perform measurements and thermal expansion calculations to ensure structural integrity over time and prevent cracking or misalignment.Build and modify scrap chutes to eliminate recurring clogging issues; Position responsibilitiesInternal communication and check-ins Join regular check-ins with Skipper leadership to align on target accounts and strategy.Come prepared with a point of view, not just a status update.Communicate proactively on scheduling conflicts, blockers, or shifts in priority. Preparation and research Research target companies and contacts to identify real entry points and angles.Work closely with Skipper leadership and stakeholders to make sure your client prep is as sharp as it can be.Learn the AI solutions Skipper AI works with well enough to speak to them credibly. Pipeline management and outreach Own and run your own outreach pipeline from first contact onward.Record interactions, take notes, and write follow-ups to keep every relationship moving.Manage scheduling and follow-up so nothing goes cold.Once an account becomes active, step into the account manager role, owning stakeholder coordination and next steps toward adoption. What you will gainFull ownership over a real client relationship, from the first outreach to active adoption.Direct access to Skipper AI leadership, working alongside the people actually building the company, not through layers of management.Hands-on experience with AI solutions and how businesses actually adopt them, not just theory.A measurable track record: accounts opened, relationships managed, and real outcomes you can point to.A front-row seat to how an early-stage AI consultancy operates and grows. Work designationThis position is fully remote. All core responsibilities are performed independently and do not require a fixed on-site schedule.The team looks for opportunities to meet in person when project timelines and individual schedules align. These gatherings are intentional but informal, driven by shared momentum rather than a fixed cadence. Skipper AI core valuesTrust and Transparency. We communicate openly, follow through on commitments, and treat every client and colleague with honesty. Trust is the foundation of every relationship we build. Humble Hunger. There's more to a failed task than the task itself; every mistake carries a lesson, and progress in anything is still progress forward. It's okay to be wrong, as long as you admit it. What matters is being hungry more often than you are wrong. Have Hard Conversations. One's success in life is directly correlated to their ability to have hard conversations. Conversations are hard if you are passionate, and two passionate people in a room is a rare thing. About Skipper AIIn the last year, we have worked with 8 companies, on countless projects, and have shipped things that did and didn't work. Importantly, we have captured the themes behind what leads to success or failure, and have not found a use case since those learnings did not apply. Skipper AI exists to not skip them. We've driven 90%+ adoption not because of the platform we picked, but because we refuse to skip the intentional steps. Intentionality through change has never been more important. The tools are the easy part; it's the steps most firms rush past, the change management in between where AI actually sticks or quietly dies.

jobs.description: Employer: Oak Ridge Institute for Science and Education Expires: 10/10/2026 Application Deadline 11/6/2026 3:00:00 PM Eastern Time ZoneDescription *Applications will be reviewed on a rolling-basis.CDC Office and Location: A research opportunity is available in the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) located in Atlanta, Georgia.The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) is one of the major operation components of the Department of Health and Human Services. CDC protects America from health, safety and security threats, both foreign and in the U.S. Whether diseases start at home or abroad, are chronic or acute, curable or preventable, human error or deliberate attack, CDC fights disease and supports communities and citizens to do the same. CDC increases the health security of our nation. As the nation’s health protection agency, CDC saves lives and protects people from health threats. To accomplish its mission, CDC conducts important science and provides health information that protects our nation against expensive and dangerous health threats, and responds when these arise.This opportunity is located within the Office of Readiness and Response [Office of Readiness and Response: Who We Are] which is a central hub for the agency - providing oversight for preparedness, readiness, and response operations.Research Project: The Office of Readiness and Response would like to welcome a Readiness Impact and Evaluation Fellow to our Strategic Capacity Building and Innovation Program (SCIP). SCIP supports investments designed to strengthen organizational readiness, preparedness capabilities, and response capacity across CDC Centers, Institutes, and Offices (CIOs). While SCIP routinely monitors project implementation, strategic utilization, and performance reporting, an opportunity exists to establish a more systematic approach for measuring and demonstrating the program's impact on readiness outcomes.Expected Activities: Collaborate on the development and planning to pilot a SCIP Readiness Impact Evaluation Framework to assess the extent to which SCIP activities contribute to measurable improvements in organizational readiness, preparedness capabilities, and operational effectiveness. You will be trained to conduct a mixed-methods evaluation of projects and activities, leveraging documentation, performance data, and stakeholder engagement to identify evidence of readiness improvements and programmatic impact.Gain experience designing a repeatable methodology that can be applied across future cycles to evaluate outcomes, assess the contribution of SCIP’s support to readiness goals, and bolstering of data-driven decision-making. Findings and recommendations will help strengthen SCIP's ability to demonstrate value, inform strategic decisions, and communicate program impact to leadership and stakeholders.Collaborate on the development of a sustainable evaluation framework for a federal investment portfolio while gaining experience in program evaluation, public health preparedness, strategic planning, and performance measurement.Learning Objectives:Build skills in designing readiness impact evaluation frameworks and scoring rubrics for SCIP-funded activitiesGain practical experience identifying and assessing readiness gaps addressing through SCIP investmentsLearn techniques for conducting comprehensive portfolio reviews and synthesizing findings from multiple data sourcesStrengthen the ability to measure and document readiness improvements resulting from funded activitiesDevelop stakeholder interviewing and qualitative analysis skills to validate findings and demonstrate program impactApply evaluation best practices to generate recommendations that enhance future impact measurement effortsMentor(s): The mentor for this opportunity is Jana Austin (aun6@cdc.gov). What matters is being hungry more often than you are wrong. Have Hard Conversations. One's success in life is directly correlated to their ability to have hard conversations. Conversations are hard if you are passionate, and two passionate people in a room is a rare thing. About Skipper AIIn the last year, we have worked with 8 companies, on countless projects, and have shipped things that did and didn't work. Importantly, we have captured the themes behind what leads to success or failure, and have not found a use case since those learnings did not apply. Skipper AI exists to not skip them. We've driven 90%+ adoption not because of the platform we picked, but because we refuse to skip the intentional steps. Intentionality through change has never been more important. The tools are the easy part; it's the steps most firms rush past, the change management in between where AI actually sticks or quietly dies.

jobs.description: Employer: Burlington Stores Expires: 10/10/2026 Sustainability Intern - Summer 2027Burlington, NJPosition OverviewSustainability Intern Job Description: If you are looking for an internship that reflects the day-to-day of a full-time associate and have an interest in a career in sustainability, environmental analytics, environmental compliance, energy management, renewable energy, or greenhouse gas emissions, we invite you to apply to our internship program as a Sustainability Intern! Our Burlington: In 1972, Burlington Stores operated as a family-owned coat business, and over the years, we have grown into one of today's leading off-price retailers and continue to evolve through collaboration, innovation, and customer focus. Centered on five tenets, “Our Burlington” defines who we are as an employer, and what is important to us as a team, and it guides us toward continued growth, innovation, and success in the off-price retail industry. Additional information is available at: https://burlingtonstores.jobs/our-burlington/ Our Internship Program: Our internship program is a starting point for a career journey at Burlington, and here is a preview of what you can expect: •A 10-week summer program featuring leadership development workshops, classroom-style training, peer-to-peer engagement, and community service projects. •Hands-on exposure through shadowing opportunities to gain insight into Burlington’s operations and the off-price retail business model. •Direct mentorship from a Burlington associate who will serve as your “buddy” for support, coaching, and guidance throughout the summer. •A hybrid schedule that aligns with team and business needs, including participation in required in-person internship programming, orientation, key meetings, and other activities as applicable. jobs.description: Employer: Hallmark Cards, Inc. Expires: 10/10/2026 2027 Summer Internship- Supply Chain Management ABOUT HALLMARK’S INTERNSHIP PROGRAMWe need sharp, energetic people to help us create, engineer, market, and deliver our products worldwide. Hallmark offers summer internships for students pursuing degrees in areas such as Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain Management, Economics, Communications, Engineering, Psychology, Statistics, Physics, Data Science, Computer Science and more! Hallmark’s internship program is held annually, starting late May and ending in early August, and provides the valuable opportunity to apply your classroom knowledge to meaningful projects in a corporate environment. In addition, you will gain exposure to Hallmark leadership, learn more about our products and initiatives, connect with employees and interns from other disciplines, and for hybrid or on-site internships, enjoy what life is like in the Kansas City metro area. POSITION OVERVIEWAs a Supply Chain Management Intern at Hallmark, you will be exposed to either the distribution and supply chain processes utilized by Hallmark to manufacture and deliver our products, or our end-to-end consumer or customer business processes and operations that enable us to deliver products to our consumers world-wide. You will work on impactful projects rooted in business need and will use your business acumen and problem-solving skills to understand Hallmark’s supply chain priorities, the goal of your project(s), and to research, strategize, develop, and potentially implement a feasible solution for your project(s) or the problem at hand. Past projects have included:Developing tools and standard operating procedures for understanding the paper supply chain from Hallmark’s suppliers to provide training opportunities to buyers and coordinators.Documenting key business operations processes; recommending and implementing process improvements that increase process efficiency, effectiveness, and performance.Optimizing Hallmark’s product flow and determining the best sourcing strategy for product, equipment, and services. This is a challenging summer internship opportunity where you will have the opportunity to present your work and recommendations to senior leaders and business partners. BASIC QUALIFICATIONSThe following is required to be considered for this role:Currently pursuing a supply chain management degree or a business degree with an emphasis in supply chain, operations, or logistics with a graduation date of December 2027, May 2028, December 2028, May 2029, December 2029, or May 2030. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONSYour resume and application will stand out if you have:GPA of 3.0 or higher (GPA must be stated on your resume).Demonstrated leadership ability.Strong communication and interpersonal skills; both written and verbal.High learning agility and problem solving skills.Excellent analytical skills.Goal and results oriented; works with urgency and a high degree of personal accountability.Manages well through ambiguity.Previous internship experience in a business, logistics, operations, engineering, or supply chain field. Interested? Follow the application instructions below to apply. APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:You must show how you meet the basic qualifications in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. Accepted file types are Microsoft Word (DOC or DOCX), PDF, HTML, or TXT.In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Hallmark does not generally provide sponsorship for employment. Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification and satisfactory reference and background checks. ADDITIONAL DETAILSAll engineering internships will be on site at one of the following locations: Hallmark Headquarters (Kansas City, MO), Liberty Distribution Center (Liberty, MO), Production Center (Lawrence, KS), or Production Center (Leavenworth, KS). All of these locations are within 45 minutes of downtown Kansas City, MO. ABOUT HALLMARK – Because Connecting With Each Other Has Never Been More Important For more than a century, Hallmark has been bringing people together and improving the relationships that matter most. That’s why millions of people all over the world connect with the Hallmark brand. It has always been a mission so much bigger than any one of us who work here. Today, we need empathetic learners, strategic thinkers, and enthusiastic visionaries with diverse experiences and skills to help us create the rest of Hallmark’s second century as we shift to a more digitally savvy, unified approach that combines the best of brick-and-mortar retail with the efficiency of dot-com spaces. Help us imagine what our next hundred years could look like!When you join Hallmark, we will go out of our way to make you feel like part of the team, even in a remote/hybrid work environment. In the day-to-day, we’ll make the best use of the skills and talents you already have. We’ll also give you leadership opportunities and show you multiple potential pathways to future success.Our culture of care for our consumers and for one another shows in the way we embrace different backgrounds, identities, and working styles, deliberately seeking out ways to be more inclusive both internally among our work groups and externally through the things we make and sell to our retail partners and consumers. We believe that a broadly inclusive, equitable approach is also our best path to future success. We’re seeking out those who can bring a fresh perspective to our business and would love your input as someone new to our team! We can only change and grow when we intentionally include new perspectives–like yours. jobs.description: Employer: Protiviti Expires: 10/10/2026 Are You Ready to Live Something Different with Protiviti? The Protiviti career provides an opportunity to learn, shape outcomes, and grow within a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture. We hire curious individuals who are motivated by learning and who are driven to make an impact. By teaming with our clients, we solve the business challenges a dynamic world presents and discover and implement innovative business solutions. We lean into our mission: We Care. We Collaborate. We Deliver. At every level, we champion leaders who live our values. Imagining our work as a journey, integrity guides our way, inclusion moves us forward together, innovation creates new destinations, and our commitment to success empowers us to deliver high-quality, client-focused outcomes in pursuit of our vision to be the most trusted global consulting firm. Are you inspired to make a difference? You've come to the right place. POSITION HIGHLIGHTSTechnology Consulting interns work with Protiviti’s clients, who are typically among the world’s leading companies. As an intern, you collaborate with the team to deliver high-quality, client-focused solutions to complex business problems these organizations face. Experience tells us that our future leaders need to be both knowledgeable and demonstrate depth in an area of expertise but also versatile, having a broad range of capabilities and skill sets to solve today’s complex business problems. That’s why we focus on developing interns across our business, so you gain experience in different industries, grow your technical and professional capabilities, and gain leadership qualities that will ensure your future success. Our culture is built on clear expectations, meaningful support, and teamwork. Interns are encouraged to contribute ideas, learn through real work, and collaborate closely with others. Our people invest in one another; coaching, guiding, and supporting each team member to grow and perform at their best.When you join our team, you will participate in Liftoff with Protiviti, our award-winning onboarding live-virtual experience with gamification embedded in the delivery. You will also attend The Intern Challenge, an experiential learning course that will help you build confidence and create connections that will help you transition successfully into your role as an intern. Protiviti’s internship is an innovative experience designed to take you on a journey to immerse you in our unique business and culture. Through our internship, you may work across various industries and engage in internal initiatives, all of which will fuel your curiosity, uncover hidden strengths, and prepare you for your career. During the internship, you will get a preview of Foundations, Protiviti’s innovative entry-level full-time career opportunity, which provides you with experiences and learning opportunities in business operations, consulting, data, relationship building, technology, and innovation. With each project, you receive hands-on training in a supportive, high-performance environment and interact with leaders across our practice. Talent Managers will assign specific project experiences that support career growth, your skills, and the needs of the business. A network of advisors will help you navigate challenges and celebrate milestones. There are opportunities to join committees, participate in employee network groups, enjoy social, civic, and networking activities to strengthen connections and build meaningful relationships across our firm and in the community. Enterprise Data, Analytics & AI: Converts internal and external data into insight and action through data engineering, governance, visualization, data sciences, ML, and AI while we diagnose issues, predict outcomes, and prescribe improvements to business performance.Microsoft: Working closely with Microsoft to maximize this ecosystem partner, driving collaboration productivity, and modernization initiatives across both the business and technology, understanding specific client needs and tailoring appropriate solutions using Microsoft technologies.Security and Privacy: Strengthens cyber resilience and data protection via risk assessments, technical testing, vulnerability remediation, incident readiness or response, and privacy services including coverage for emerging technology such as Internet of Things (IoT) penetration testing and quantum computing.Technology Risk and Resilience: Builds right-sized enterprise risk and resilience capabilities across the business, technology, cyber and third-party domains aligning to regulations and leading practices, translating risk into actionable programs, and operationalizing them at scale.Technology Strategy and Architecture: Helps clients understand and improve how they use technology and how technology can enable them to meet their big-picture strategies. jobs.title: 2L Rule 13 Intern at Greene County Government
jobs.description: Employer: Greene County Government Expires: 10/10/2026 SUMMER LEGAL INTERNSHIP & SEMESTER IN PRACTICE Step into the courtroom from day one. The Greene County Prosecuting Attorney's Office offers 2L and 3L law students an unparalleled opportunity to practice law, not just observe it. If you're passionate about criminal justice and ready to make an immediate impact on your community, this is your chance to gain hands-on courtroom experience that will set you apart in your legal career. WHO WE ARE As the largest law office in Southwest Missouri, we are ministers of justice dedicated to ensuring fairness, effectiveness, and efficiency through advocacy and community leadership. Our award-winning team of prosecutors handles everything from traffic violations to complex felony cases, and we're committed to mentoring the next generation of legal professionals. WHERE YOU'LL WORK Springfield, Missouri offers the perfect balance for launching your legal career. With a population of 169,000, you'll enjoy big-city amenities—world-class healthcare, vibrant entertainment, rich cultural experiences—without the stress and expense. Nestled in the scenic Ozarks, Springfield provides exceptional outdoor recreation, a welcoming community, affordable living, and a quality of life that lets you focus on what matters: becoming an excellent attorney.WHAT YOU'LL DO Prosecute real cases under Rule 13 supervision—from your first week Handle bond hearings, preliminary hearings, motions, and trials Work on cases spanning the full spectrum of criminal law, from misdemeanors to serious felonies Conduct witness interviews and prepare witnesses for testimony Draft charging documents, motions, and legal memoranda Collaborate with law enforcement and victim advocates Make judgment calls that directly impact public safety and justiceWHAT WE OFFER Immediate courtroom experience that exceeds what most new attorneys get in their first year of practice Direct mentorship from experienced prosecutors who are invested in your development Structured training and professional development tailored to your skill level Exposure to diverse practice areas and case types that will inform your career direction The satisfaction of serving your community and protecting public safety A supportive, team-oriented environment where your contributions matter Practical skills that will make you competitive in any legal marketWHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 2L or 3L law students eligible for practice under Missouri Supreme Court Rule 13 Strong academic credentials and excellent legal writing skills Demonstrated commitment to public service and the pursuit of justice Effective oral advocacy and communication abilities Team-oriented mindset with integrity and professionalism Desire to take on responsibility and learn through real-world experience WHY CHOOSE PROSECUTION Unlike private sector internships where you might spend months on research and document review, you'll be in court making arguments, examining witnesses, and developing the trial skills that define great lawyers. You'll work on cases that shape public policy and protect vulnerable members of your community. READY TO START YOUR LEGAL CAREER? If you're ready to step beyond the classroom and into the courtroom, we want to hear from you. Join a team that's committed to justice, invested in your growth, and ready to give you the experience you need to succeed.

jobs.title: Wealth Management Intern at OnePoint BFG Wealth Partners
jobs.description: Employer: OnePoint BFG Wealth Partners Expires: 10/10/2026 Formerly Bleakley Financial Group, OnePoint BFG Wealth Partners is a premier financial planning and wealth management firm dedicated to delivering tailored financial strategies to individuals, families, and businesses. Founded in 1985, OnePoint BFG's advisors manage over $18 billion in advisory assets and provide personalized, goals-based planning with an unwavering focus on client well-being and legacy. As a vital member of the Minneapolis team, the Wealth Management Intern will deliver premier support to OnePoint Wealth Advisors and their clients.Position Overview:As an integral part of OnePoint BFG, the Wealth Management Intern will work directly out of our downtown Minneapolis office alongside firm Partners and industry leaders, gaining immersive, real-world experience in independent wealth management. In this role, you will drive key facets of our firm's fee-based financial planning workflows. You will specialize in complex case analysis, financial framework development, client data architecture, and custom asset-reporting initiatives—all while maintaining a concierge-level service standard for internal and external stakeholders.Key Responsibilities:Financial Architecture & Design: Partner with senior planners to build comprehensive financial plans, high-impact client presentations, and specialized meeting frameworks.Case Analysis: Synthesize complex asset data and execute precise case analysis within financial planning software applications.Investment Proposal Construction: Formulate tailored, institutional investment proposals for prospective and incoming clients.Data Management: Manage the Client Relationship Management (CRM) ecosystem efficiently, championing data integrity and advisory team standards.Operational Oversight: Organize client case timelines, tracking meeting follow-ups and action items within the CRM to ensure flawless execution.Strategic Team Support: Collaborate alongside the Planning & Client Service teams to streamline daily operational workflows, compliance procedures, and custom firm initiatives.Qualifications:Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a financial planning-related discipline.Strong experience of the Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook); familiarity with CRM architecture or financial planning platforms is a strong plus.Exceptional analytical capabilities, rapid problem-solving skills, and sharp written and verbal communication.A disciplined professional demeanor with a client-first heart and an uncompromised commitment to maintaining strict confidentiality.An energetic self-starter who thrives with professional autonomy, excels at multitasking, and adapts seamlessly to high-growth environments. Self-starter, energetic, and eager to learn.Why Join Us:Joining our team means becoming part of an organization recognized by Financial Planning as one of the premier RIAs to work for—a distinction reflecting our deep commitment to our people, our culture, and our collective vision.Impactful Growth: Play a visible role in a top-tier independent firm where your contributions directly support a rapidly scaling, relationship-first organization.Award-Winning Culture: Immerse yourself in a collaborative, supportive environment that treats early-career talent as the future leaders of our industry.Competitive Rewards: We offer a top-tier salary and a structured professional framework designed to reward high performers.Professional Advancement: Benefit from direct mentorship under senior Partners, continuing education opportunities, and long-term career progression tracks.Right to Revise:This job description outlines the general nature and level of work performed by personnel in this role; it is not a comprehensive inventory of all duties or a formal contract for employment. Employment remains strictly at-will.This is a non-exempt, hourly position. Standard full-time scheduling is 40 hours per week, with accurate daily time-tracking required. In compliance with the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), any additional hours worked over 40 within a single workweek will be compensated at the applicable overtime rate (1.5x hourly wage).The position is based on-site in downtown Minneapolis, MN, with potential remote flex-work arrangements subject to agreement with firm leadership.

Based in our downtown Chicago office, Summer Associates work alongside Meridian consultants on client and firm projects while developing the analytical, communication, and professional skills needed to succeed in consulting.Throughout the summer, you’ll participate in structured training and professional development opportunities designed to deepen your understanding of executive compensation and consulting. jobs.title: Student Trainee (Associate FCA Bank Examiner) at Farm Credit Administration
jobs.description: Employer: Farm Credit Administration - Office of Examination Expires: 10/10/2026 Student Trainee (Associate FCA Bank Examiner)Sacramento, CA / Greenwood Village, CO / Bloomington, MN / Irving, TX / McLean, VA | Hybrid | Full-Time InternshipAbout the RoleThis internship puts you inside a federal financial regulator from day one. As an Associate FCA Bank Examiner intern, you'll work alongside experienced examiners reviewing Farm Credit System institutions — getting real exposure to credit and compliance examination, not just observation.What you'll do- Sit in on and contribute to credit examinations and compliance reviews of Farm Credit System institutions. - Dig into loan files to understand the five credit factors — character, capital, capacity, collateral, and condition — how they interact, and why they matter. - Participate in a comprehensive group analytical project focused on the Farm Credit System. - Communicate directly with Farm Credit System personnel and agency staff, practicing active listening and clear written and verbal communication. - Work as part of a team, learning how to collaborate effectively in a professional setting. - Manage your own workload and deadlines, building habits around organizing tasks and delivering accurate work on time.About you- Currently enrolled in a degree program in finance, accounting, economics, agricultural economics, business, or a related field. - Curious about financial regulation, credit analysis, or agricultural lending — you don't need experience, just genuine interest. - Comfortable communicating in writing and in person. - Organized and able to manage multiple tasks without losing the details.The Farm Credit Administration (FCA) is an independent federal agency that regulates and examines the Farm Credit System, a network of borrower-owned financial institutions that provide credit to American agriculture. This internship is a real look at how federal financial oversight works.RequirementsConditions of employmentMust be a U.S. citizen.Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service.Resume and supporting documents (See How to Apply)Suitability for Federal employment, as determined by a background investigation.Employment will begin on or about May 16, 2027.You may be required to travel up to 20 nights (4 weeks) over the summer.Must possess or be able to obtain a valid Driver's License prior to employment, due to frequent travel to remote locations.Must be able to work full-time during summer break.Must be at least 16 years of age.Complete the initial online assessment and USAHire Assessment, if requiredQualificationsAs a Pathways Intern, you must meet and comply with PROGRAM REQUIREMENTS:Maintain your enrollment on at least a half-time basis at qualifying educational institution. Half-time is typically 6 semester hours for undergraduate and 3 semester hours for graduate students but may be defined differently by your educational institution;Provide course registration information at the start of each school term and verification of academic status (transcript) at the end of each academic term;Meet and maintain the required GPA;Sign a Pathways Internship agreement that sets forth the expectations for the internship upon entry on duty;Have the ability to work a full-time schedule (40 hours/week) during your summer break from school; andBe available for occasional weekday travel away from your duty location. Failure to meet or maintain qualifications or program requirements or failure to provide required documentation will result in termination of your appointment.In addition, you must meet STUDENT STATUS REQUIREMENTS to be eligible for this internship opportunity. You must:Be enrolled as a student in an accredited 4-year college/university Bachelor's or Master's degree program on at least a half-time basis;Have substantially completed 3 academic years of progressive, higher-level education, i.e., be a current college junior or higher. Three full academic years of undergraduate or graduate education is the number of credit hours determined by your college/university to represent three years of full-time study;Provide proof that you have completed your third academic year of higher-level education by submitting an official transcript at the end of your school's 2027 spring term;Have and maintain a cumulative grade point average (GPA) of at least 2.95 on a 4-point scale. If your school uses an alternate grading system, you must submit proof and explanation of the grading system with your application or you will not be considered for this position;Have a planned graduation date not earlier than August 2027 and no later than June 2028; andBe in good academic standing (e.g., not on academic probation).If you graduate before August 2027 you are not eligible for this Pathways Internship unless you are pursuing further education and provide proof of enrollment or acceptance into a degree or certificate seeking program with your application. If you aren't planning to pursue further education at this time, you may qualify for a permanent position under the Pathways Recent Graduates program. Please see vacancy announcement https://www.usajobs.gov/GetJob/ViewDetails/884010300 for requirements.BAND/GRADE LEVEL: In addition to meeting the Student Status and Educational Requirements you qualify at the VH-32 (GS-5 equivalent) band level if you have completed 1) at least 2 full academic years of post-high school study or 2) an associate's degree.EducationYou must meet EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS to qualify for this internship. Your undergraduate or graduate-level education must be in one of the following major fields of study:AccountingAgribusinessAgricultural BusinessAgricultural FinanceAgricultural EconomicsAnimal/Dairy ScienceBankingBusiness AdministrationCommercial or Banking LawEconomicsFinanceMarketingAnalytical FinanceMathematicsOther areas of major study directly related to the work of the internship position such as agricultural sciences, statistics, data analytics, management information systems, public policy.You MUST submit copies of your transcript(s) that include: your name, the name of the educational institution, course titles, number of semester/quarter hours, cumulative GPA, grade(s) earned and degree(s) awarded. Unless otherwise stated: (1) official or unofficial transcripts are acceptable at the time of application, or (2) you may submit a list with all of your courses, grades, semester, year, and credit for the course. Educational institutions must be accredited by one of the accrediting agencies or associations recognized by the U.S. Department of Education.PASS/FAIL COURSES: If more than 10 percent of your undergraduate course work (credit hours) were taken on a pass/fail basis, your claim of superior academic achievement must be based upon class standing or membership in an honor societyGRADUATE EDUCATION: One academic year of graduate education is the number of credits hours your graduate school has determined to represent one academic year of full-time study. Such study may have been performed on a full-time or part-time basis. If you cannot obtain your graduate school's definition of one year of graduate study, 18 semester hours (or 27 quarter hours) should be considered as satisfying the requirement for one year of full-time graduate study.FOREIGN EDUCATION: If you are using education completed in foreign colleges or universities to meet the qualification requirements, you must show the education credentials have been evaluated by a private organization that specializes in interpretation of foreign education programs and such education has been deemed equivalent to that gained in an accredited U.S. education program; or full credit has been given for the courses at a U.S. accredited college or university. For further information, visit: https://www.ed.gov/laws-and-policy/higher-education-laws-and-policy/college-accreditationAdditional informationStarting salaries (base): $38,143 per year. Locality pay is added to base salary using on the following locality rates: Bloomington, MN, 27.62%; Irving, TX, 27.26%; McLean, VA, 33.74%; Greenwood Village, CO, 30.52%; Sacramento, CA, 29.76%. Locality rates are subject to change.Candidates selected for the Internship may elect to receive a one-time $2,000-$2,500 stipend (in addition to bi-weekly salary) at the beginning of the program. Certain stipulations apply.In addition, selectees may be eligible for a $10,000 recruitment bonus upon conversion.Only experience and education obtained by the closing date of this announcement will be considered.All FCA employees are subject to the conflict-of-interest laws and Standards of Ethical Conduct imposed upon all employees of the Executive Branch of the Federal Government and may be required to file a Financial Disclosure Report.FCA's supplemental ethics regulations restrict certain FCA employees concerning their direct or indirect interests in, or connections with, Farm Credit System institutions. These rules also require all employees to obtain approval for outside employment or business activities. Please contact the HR Division for additional information on these rules.FCA uses E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees.This announcement may be used to fill similar vacancies.Program Completion and Conversion Eligibility: You may be non-competitively converted to a term, career-conditional or career appointment, within 120 days following successful completion of all of your educational and work experience requirements (480 hours of which 320 hours may be waived for interns who demonstrate high potential as demonstrated by outstanding academic achievement and exceptional job performance) in accordance with 5 CFR 362.204, at the discretion of the Agency.Conversion is not automatic nor guaranteed. If you meet program requirements and are approved for conversion, you will be appointed at the grade level for which you are qualified to a FCA Examiner position, which has promotion potential to the VH-39 (GS-13) band level.The Fair Chance to Compete for Jobs Act of 2019, with some exceptions, prohibits the Farm Credit Administration from requesting an applicant's criminal history record before that individual receives a conditional offer of employment. If you apply to this position and are selected, we will not ask about your criminal history before you receive a conditional job offer. If you believe you were asked about your criminal history improperly, visit our website at (Careers at FCA | Farm Credit Administration) for information on filing a complaint.Candidates should be committed to improving the efficiency of the Federal government, passionate about the ideals of our American republic, and committed to upholding the rule of law and the United States Constitution.

jobs.description: Employer: Protiviti Expires: 10/10/2026 Legal, Risk and Compliance Intern - 2027 Are You Ready to Live Something Different with Protiviti? The Protiviti career provides an opportunity to learn, shape outcomes, and grow within a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture. We hire curious individuals who are motivated by learning and who are driven to make an impact. By teaming with our clients, we solve the business challenges a dynamic world presents and discover and implement innovative business solutions. We lean into our mission: We Care. We Collaborate. We Deliver. At every level, we champion leaders who live our values. Imagining our work as a journey, integrity guides our way, inclusion moves us forward together, innovation creates new destinations, and our commitment to success empowers us to deliver high-quality, client-focused outcomes in pursuit of our vision to be the most trusted global consulting firm. Are you inspired to make a difference? You've come to the right place. POSITION HIGHLIGHTSLegal, Risk and Compliance interns work with Protiviti’s clients, who are typically among the world’s leading companies. As an intern, you collaborate with the team to deliver high-quality client-focused solutions to complex business problems these organizations face. Experience tells us that our future leaders need to be both knowledgeable and demonstrate depth in an area of expertise but also versatile, having a broad range of capabilities and skill sets to solve today’s complex business problems. Our culture is built on clear expectations, meaningful support, and teamwork. Interns are encouraged to contribute ideas, learn through real work, and collaborate closely with others. Our people invest in one another; coaching, guiding, and supporting each team member to grow and perform at their best. When you join our team, you will participate in Liftoff with Protiviti, our award-winning onboarding live-virtual experience with gamification embedded in the delivery. You will also attend The Intern Challenge, an experiential learning course that will help build confidence and create connections that will help you transition successfully into your role as an intern. Protiviti’s internship is an innovative experience designed to take you on a journey to immerse you in our unique business and culture. Through our internship, you may work across various industries and engage in internal initiatives, all of which will fuel your curiosity, uncover hidden strengths, and prepare you for your career. During the internship, you will get a preview of Foundations, Protiviti’s innovative entry-level full-time career opportunity, which provides you with experiences and learning opportunities in business operations, consulting, data, relationship building, technology, and innovation. With each project, you receive hands-on training in a supportive, high-performance environment and interact with leaders across our practice. Talent Managers will assign specific project experiences that support career growth, your skills, and the needs of the business. A network of advisors will help you navigate challenges and celebrate milestones. There are opportunities to join committees, participate in employee network groups, enjoy social, civic, and networking activities to strengthen connections and build meaningful relationships across our firm and in the community. Legal, Risk and Compliance interns develop knowledge in core business processes within the financial services, technology, and healthcare industries. Interns will work within internal control and risk frameworks, as well as regulator and compliance methodologies. Legal, Risk and Compliance interns will help develop key deliverables, including process flows, work programs, reports, and control summaries. Interns will review transactions to provide process improvement recommendations and address legal, risk and compliance challenges as needed. Legal, Risk and Compliance interns will work within various segments, including but not limited to financial crime and anti-money laundering, risk management, credit services, regulatory compliance and consumer protection, analytics, and legal consulting. Meaningful onboarding. Impactful training. Foundational learning. These experiences define Protiviti’s award-winning internship – an experience that builds upon your skills and knowledge and enables you to thrive. This model creates meaningful experiences for our people and our clients while offering a flexible environment. We encourage thoughtful choices about where work happens – making decisions that best support client outcomes, team effectiveness and learning. The requirements will vary by client, project, team and other business factors. Our people work both in-person in local Protiviti offices and on client sites, which can include local or out-of-state travel based on our projects and client requests and commitments. Interns do not accrue company paid time off (Choice Time Off), and we expect that interns will be available to complete work in the designated location during business hours for the entire duration of the Internship. Prepare annual business interruption and property renewal values for companies in various industries. Analyze financial statements and other pertinent documentation. Develop sensitivity analyses related to loss measurements. Reconciliation of claim amounts to accounting systems and to insurers’ calculations. jobs.title: Protiviti Business Performance Improvement Intern - 2027 at Protiviti
jobs.description: Employer: Protiviti Expires: 10/11/2026 Protiviti Business Performance Improvement Intern - 2027 Are You Ready to Live Something Different with Protiviti? The Protiviti career provides an opportunity to learn, shape outcomes, and grow within a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture. We hire curious individuals who are motivated by learning and who are driven to make an impact. By teaming with our clients, we solve the business challenges a dynamic world presents and discover and implement innovative business solutions. We lean into our mission: We Care. We Collaborate. We Deliver. At every level, we champion leaders who live our values. Imagining our work as a journey, integrity guides our way, inclusion moves us forward together, innovation creates new destinations, and our commitment to success empowers us to deliver high-quality, client-focused outcomes in pursuit of our vision to be the most trusted global consulting firm. Are you inspired to make a difference? You've come to the right place. POSITION HIGHLIGHTS Business Performance Improvement interns help clients in the areas of finance, operations, people and change. Our Interns work with Protiviti’s clients, who are typically among the world’s leading companies. As an intern, you collaborate with the team to deliver high- quality, client-focused solutions to complex business problems these organizations face. Experience tells us that our future leaders need to be both knowledgeable and demonstrate depth in an area of expertise but also versatile, having a broad range of capabilities and skill sets to solve today’s complex business problems. That’s why we focus on developing interns across our business, so you gain experience in different industries, grow your technical and professional capabilities, and gain leadership qualities that will ensure your future success. Our culture is built on clear expectations, meaningful support, and teamwork. Interns are encouraged to contribute ideas, learn through real work, and collaborate closely with others. Our people invest in one another; coaching, guiding, and supporting each team member to grow and perform at their best.When you join our team, you will participate in Liftoff with Protiviti, our award-winning onboarding live-virtual experience with gamification embedded in the delivery. You will also attend The Intern Challenge, an experiential learning course that will help you build confidence and create connections that will help you transition successfully into your role as an intern. Protiviti’s internship is an innovative experience designed to take you on a journey to immerse you in our unique business and culture. Through our internship, you may work across various industries and engage in internal initiatives, all of which will fuel your curiosity, uncover hidden strengths, and prepare you for your career. During the internship, you will get a preview of Foundations, Protiviti’s innovative entry-level full-time career opportunity, which provides you with experiences and learning opportunities in business operations, consulting, data, relationship building, technology, and innovation. With each project, you receive hands-on training in a supportive, high-performance environment and interact with leaders across our practice. Talent Managers will assign specific project experiences that support career growth, your skills, and the needs of the business. A network of advisors will help you navigate challenges and celebrate milestones. There are opportunities to join committees, participate in employee network groups, enjoy social, civic, and networking activities to strengthen connections and build meaningful relationships across our firm and in the community. Business Performance Improvement interns are hired into one of four different areas, including:Finance Performance Management: Provides custom solutions to help finance leaders address their current challenges and explore opportunities for continuous growth, delivering innovative solutions and supporting finance as a forward-thinking, strategic partner to the business. At the core, our methodology aligns people, processes, and technology to drive efficiency, productivity, and transformation, enabling change and creating value for the entire client organization.Financial Reporting Remediation & Compliance: Supports companies in navigating complex financial reporting situations to reduce their risk of non-compliance while limiting exposure to financial restatements and other costly non-routine situations such as restatements, mergers, and IPOs. Protiviti’s team proactively monitors new accounting rules, alerts clients to changing requirements, and assists with addressing complex accounting or reporting challenges.People & Change: Focuses on the human side of transformation by helping companies with the people, talent, and skills components of their business. We assist organizations in developing differentiated employee experiences to better attract, retain, and engage talent. We also help organizations enable sustained behavior changes to support large-scale initiatives. Supply Chain & Operations: Supports companies in driving outcomes by reducing cost, improving efficiency, reducing risk and executing operations across their complex business functions from Engineering, Source, Make and Deliver through industry-leading practices and innovation. Meaningful onboarding. Impactful training. Foundational learning. These experiences define Protiviti’s award-winning internship – an experience that builds upon your skills and knowledge and enables you to thrive professionally. QUALIFICATIONSDegree: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Project Management, Supply Chain, or other business majors) Visa Status: All applicants applying for U.S. job openings need authorization to work in the United States for Protiviti without sponsorship now or in the futureGraduation Status: Must be within one year of final graduation at the time of internshipExperience solving problems using AI-powered productivity and collaboration tools (i.e. Microsoft Copilot, GenAI, etc.)Advanced verbal and written communication skillsAbility to apply critical thinking skills and innovation to client engagements across various industriesTechnical proficiency aligning to assigned capability area WHAT MAKES YOU SUCCESSFULWorks effectively in teams, as well as independentlyBeing creative and analyticalPassionate about evaluating, synthesizing, organizing, and interpreting data and informationEmbraces challenges with a growth mindset and contributes to meaningful outcomesSeeks feedback and guidance to strengthen performanceDrive towards obtaining professional certifications and a strong academic backgroundRelevant experience with specific skills:A foundation in accounting and finance processes and objectivesDocumenting findings and sharing recommendationsEntry level knowledge of organizational operations processes and objectives HOW WE WORK Protiviti practices a hybrid model, combining in-person with purpose and remote work to best support excellent work, connection and collaboration. This model creates meaningful experiences for our people and our clients while offering a flexible environment. We encourage thoughtful choices about where work happens – making decisions that best support client outcomes, team effectiveness and learning. The requirements will vary by client, project, team and other business factors. Our people work both in-person in local Protiviti offices and on client sites, which can include local or out-of-state travel based on our projects and client requests and commitments. Interns do not accrue company paid time off (Choice Time Off), and we expect that interns will be available to complete work in the designated location during business hours for the entire duration of the Internship. APPLICATION PROCESS Apply at www.protiviti.com/careers.Note: Students may apply for only one location or capability. Duplicate applications will not be accepted. Applicants must be 18 years of age at the time of the internship to be considered. #LI-DNI The hourly rate for this position is below.$28/hr-$38/hr Interns participate in a variety of professional development opportunities and are eligible for paid holidays that occur within the duration of the internship, Protiviti’s 401(k) plan, Employee Assistance Program, Matching Gifts Program, and various discounts through PerkSpot. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to apply for a position, please contact us by sending an email to HRSolutions@roberthalf.com or call 1.855.744.6947 for assistance. jobs.title: International Vendor Coordinator at Namify
jobs.description: Employer: Namify Expires: 10/11/2026 ABOUT US:Namify is in the business of belonging. For over 20 years, companies of all sizes have partnered with us to elevate their recognition programs, corporate gifting strategies, branding initiatives, and employee engagement. Through automation and more sustainable practices, we are revolutionizing the swag industry which has traditionally been wasteful and awkward. We’re growing fast because the world recognizes how desperately services like ours are needed. Now we are looking for energetic “inclusion superheroes” to join our team. So, if you are a detail-oriented person and like the idea of creating more happiness in the workplace, we want to talk to you … like yesterday.ABOUT THIS JOB:As an International Vendor Coordinator Intern, you will support a variety of projects related to process optimization, market analysis, and cross-border communication initiatives. This temporary internship provides hands-on experience in a global business environment, with opportunities to develop problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.The ideal candidate will be pursuing a degree in Global Supply Chain Management, International Relations, Business Administration, Economics, or a related business field and will be comfortable working across different cultures, teams, and time zones as needed.RESPONSIBILITIES:● Manage correspondence between international teams, vendors, and partner organizations● Conduct market research and analyze operational data● Prepare reports for management● Assist with process optimization initiatives and project management tasks● Audit product costs, weights, and dimensions for accuracy and efficiency● Review vendor costs and key processes to identify opportunities for accuracy and efficiency● Assist with compliance documentation● Support logistics planning● Participate in meetings with vendors or partner organizations● Collaborate with teams across different countries● Perform other related duties as assignedTaking ownership and pride in these tasks will allow you to thrive in this position for the benefit of both your team, Namify and our clients, and most importantly yourself. A reflection of your care and dedication to our client’s needs will be seen in the quality of your work, and won’t go overlooked. You are to be accountable for results and should take ownership of your area, processes, and communications seriously, while still having a rewarding and pleasant experience working for our company.
